quest.title: Seirai Stormchasers: Part II
quest.description: After arriving on Seirai island, you meet two adventurers who are currently investigating something known as a Warding Stone. But following the footprints of a cat, you arrive at a dilapidated shrine, in which sits a cat named "Neko," who proclaims itself to be the "provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine." After you help "Neko" repair the shrine's Offering Box, it reveals the method of sealing the Warding Stones to you. Additionally, you learn that should you be able to seal all four Warding Stones throughout Seirai Island, you can calm the thunderstorm that enshrouds it.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x25000

talks.objective: Go to seal the Warding Stone

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: That's the second Warding Stone sealed. Only two left.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Let's look at remaining two Warding Stones.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: As long as we seal all the Warding Stones, that should calm the storm.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: I sure hope that what this "Neko" says is true...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Well, it is our only lead concerning the storm...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Whatever the case may be, let's just have a look at those Warding Stones first.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: The storm and these Warding Stones... We'll have to write a pretty detailed report for the Guild later...

choices.text: Let's get closer to them at least.
